text: How many of the letters in NEWCASTLE are vowels?
why: E, A and E: three vowels in nine letters.

text: What is the smallest number of UK coins that add up to exactly 87p?
Four of these numbers are square numbers and one is not: 9, 16, 25, 27, 36. Which one is not?
why: The others are square numbers (3², 4², 5², 6²); 27 is not.

text: Halfway through a 20-question quiz you have 7 right. How many of the last 10 must you get right to finish with three-quarters right?
A recipe needs 3 eggs to make 12 cupcakes. How many eggs do you need for 20 cupcakes?
why: That's one egg for every 4 cupcakes, and 20 ÷ 4 = 5.
